### data/zetaris/explore_ads_pg.sql

**[1]** Q1. Did paid spend and clicks change between the prior week (5-11 Oct) and last week (12-18 Oct), by channel? Result: paid_search spend fell 14,152.43 -> 9,910.83 USD (-30%) and clicks 7,926 -> 4,683 (-41%). display (1,690 -> 1,651) and paid_social (5,714 -> 5,649) were flat.

```sql
SELECT c.channel,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN s.spend_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN s.spend_usd END), 2) AS spend_prior,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN s.spend_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN s.spend_usd END), 2) AS spend_last,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.spend_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN s.clicks END) AS clicks_prior,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.spend_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN s.clicks END) AS clicks_last
FROM ads_pg.ad_spend_daily s JOIN ads_pg.campaigns c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY c.channel
ORDER BY c.channel
```

Result (3 rows, 378 ms):

| channel | spend_prior | spend_last | clicks_prior | clicks_last |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| display | 1690.07 | 1651.31 | 3053 | 2990 |
| paid_search | 14152.43 | 9910.83 | 7926 | 4683 |
| paid_social | 5713.68 | 5649.39 | 5711 | 5704 |

**[2]** Q2. What changed in the ad accounts during those two weeks? Result: two changes. 13 Oct 09:12 Brand Search - North America daily_budget 1200 -> 500 (ops-bot, Q4 budget rebalance); 14 Oct 11:45 Social - Retargeting creative carousel_v3 -> video_v1.

```sql
SELECT l.changed_at, c.campaign_name, l.change_type, l.old_value, l.new_value, l.changed_by
FROM ads_pg.ad_change_log l JOIN ads_pg.campaigns c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
WHERE to_date(l.changed_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY l.changed_at
```

Result (2 rows, 203 ms):

| changed_at | campaign_name | change_type | old_value | new_value | changed_by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-13 09:12:00.0 | Brand Search - North America | daily_budget | 1200 | 500 | ops-bot (Q4 budget rebalance) |
| 2026-10-14 11:45:00.0 | Social - Retargeting | creative | carousel_v3 | video_v1 | jordan.lee |

**[3]** Q3. Day by day, what did Brand Search (campaign 101) spend and earn in clicks around the change? Result: about 1,080-1,190 USD and 776-968 clicks a day until Mon 12 Oct; from Tue 13 Oct 465-491 USD and 331-368 clicks. CPC stays 1.23-1.44, so the clicks fell with the budget, not with price.

```sql
SELECT spend_date, date_format(spend_date, 'E') AS dow, spend_usd, clicks, round(spend_usd / clicks, 2) AS cpc
FROM ads_pg.ad_spend_daily
WHERE campaign_id = 101 AND spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-08' AND DATE '2026-10-16'
ORDER BY spend_date
```

### data/zetaris/explore_app_pg.sql

**[1]** Q1. Does the dashboard metric (trial_signup analytics events) agree with the backend (accounts actually created), by device and week? Result: desktop tracked 1,309 -> 1,171 vs created 1,334 -> 1,200 (gap 25 -> 29, normal). mobile tracked 851 -> 600 but created 871 -> 800: the gap jumps from 20 to 200 last week.

```sql
SELECT t.device, t.week, t.tracked, a.created, a.created - t.tracked AS gap
FROM (SELECT device, CASE WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'last' END AS week, sum(signups) AS tracked
      FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
      WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
      GROUP BY device, CASE WHEN signup_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'last' END) t
JOIN (SELECT device, CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'last' END AS week, count(*) AS created
      FROM app_pg.accounts
      WHERE to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
      GROUP BY device, CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'last' END) a
  ON t.device = a.device AND t.week = a.week
ORDER BY t.device, t.week DESC
```

Result (4 rows, 317 ms):

| device | week | tracked | created | gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| desktop | prior | 1309 | 1334 | 25 |
| desktop | last | 1171 | 1200 | 29 |
| mobile | prior | 851 | 871 | 20 |
| mobile | last | 600 | 800 | 200 |

**[2]** Q2. Where in the signup funnel does mobile lose events? Form submits vs trial_signup events per week. Result: mobile signup_form_submit 871 -> 800 (in line with accounts) but mobile trial_signup 851 -> 600. Desktop events move together (submit 1,334 -> 1,200, trial_signup 1,309 -> 1,171).

```sql
SELECT device, event_name,
       sum(CASE WHEN event_date < DATE '2026-10-12' THEN event_count END) AS prior_week,
       sum(CASE WHEN event_date >= DATE '2026-10-12' THEN event_count END) AS last_week
FROM app_pg.tracking_events_daily
WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY device, event_name
ORDER BY device, event_name
```

Result (6 rows, 195 ms):

| device | event_name | prior_week | last_week |
|---|---|---|---|
| desktop | signup_form_submit | 1334 | 1200 |
| desktop | signup_form_view | 3499 | 3159 |
| desktop | trial_signup | 1309 | 1171 |
| mobile | signup_form_submit | 871 | 800 |
| mobile | signup_form_view | 2308 | 2085 |
| mobile | trial_signup | 851 | 600 |

**[3]** Q3. What shipped in October, and did pricing change recently? Result: 4.12.0 signup-web "new multi-step mobile stepper" shipped 13 Oct 15:40; 4.12.1 (16 Oct) was a pricing-copy fix. Prices last changed 1 Jun 2026 (starter 29, pro 79), so pricing is not a cause.

```sql
SELECT 'release' AS kind, CAST(released_at AS STRING) AS at, concat(version, ' ', component, ': ', description) AS what
FROM app_pg.release_log WHERE to_date(released_at) >= DATE '2026-10-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'price', CAST(effective_date AS STRING), concat(plan, ' = $', CAST(monthly_price_usd AS STRING))
FROM app_pg.pricing_history
ORDER BY at
```

Result (6 rows, 200 ms):

| kind | at | what |
|---|---|---|
| price | 2026-01-01 | starter = $25 |
| price | 2026-01-01 | pro = $69 |
| price | 2026-06-01 | starter = $29 |
| price | 2026-06-01 | pro = $79 |
| release | 2026-10-13 15:40:00 | 4.12.0 signup-web: Signup form redesign: new multi-step mobile stepper |
| release | 2026-10-16 11:10:00 | 4.12.1 marketing-site: Fix pricing toggle copy |


### data/zetaris/explore_holidays.sql

**[1]** Q1. Which Canadian public holidays fall in the investigation window (Sep-Nov 2026), and are they federal? Result: Labour Day (Mon 7 Sep), National Day for Truth and Reconciliation and Orange Shirt Day (both Wed 30 Sep), Thanksgiving (Mon 12 Oct, federal), Remembrance Day (Wed 11 Nov). Only Thanksgiving is in the two weeks.

```sql
SELECT holiday_date, date_format(holiday_date, 'E') AS dow, holiday_name, is_federal
FROM whybot.ca_holidays
WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-11-30'
ORDER BY holiday_date
```

Result (5 rows, 490 ms):

| holiday_date | dow | holiday_name | is_federal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-09-07 | Mon | Labour Day | 1 |
| 2026-09-30 | Wed | National Day for Truth and Reconciliation | 1 |
| 2026-09-30 | Wed | Orange Shirt Day | 0 |
| 2026-10-12 | Mon | Thanksgiving | 1 |
| 2026-11-11 | Wed | Remembrance Day | 1 |

**[2]** Q2. How many holiday rows does the live API return per month, and how many are federal? Result: 31 holidays for 2026 across 12 months, 12 of them federal. Several dates carry more than one holiday (31 rows, 21 distinct dates), which matters when holiday_date is used as a key in the USL.

```sql
SELECT month(holiday_date) AS month, count(*) AS holidays, sum(CASE WHEN is_federal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS federal
FROM whybot.ca_holidays
GROUP BY month(holiday_date)
ORDER BY month
```

**[3]** Q3. Cross-source: daily backend accounts in the two weeks, flagged with any holiday that day (app_pg x holidays_rest). Result: weekdays run 301-369 accounts; Thanksgiving Monday (12 Oct) has 278, then Tue-Fri recover to 301-328. The holiday explains a one-day dip, not the week-long drop.

```sql
SELECT to_date(a.created_at) AS day, date_format(to_date(a.created_at), 'E') AS dow, count(*) AS accounts, max(h.holiday_name) AS holiday
FROM app_pg.accounts a LEFT JOIN whybot.ca_holidays h ON to_date(a.created_at) = h.holiday_date
WHERE to_date(a.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY to_date(a.created_at)
ORDER BY day
```
